status: read-only contract research; not supported or implemented
scope: Preserves the original research and its correction. Packaging is not a new implementation, support claim, benchmark or runtime validation; subsequent Bool Cast changes and CT consumer runs are outside this snapshot.
conclusion: The selected artifact is a real missing channel-weight/token-activation FP8 domain; existing block128 descriptors do not describe it. Metadata alone does not identify a unique deployment quantizer or dot accuracy contract.

There are mature source-level building blocks. Locked Torch has Linux SM89 rowwise FP8 but explicitly excludes Windows. Fixed cuBLAS13.3 documents native outer-vector FP8 scaling on SM90; SM89 tensorwide unit-scale FP8 dot plus ordered ordinary pointwise scales is a natural distinct deployment candidate.

The previous seven-shape native FP8 dot smoke failed the strict existing F32 dot bound. Therefore no mature FP8 Tensor Core candidate may silently replace Cast(FP8,F32)+ordinary F32 MatMul or fixed CT BF16 QDQ.

contract_boundaries.ct_bf16_qdq_reference: The fixed CT Python reference quantizes and dequantizes in the participating tensor/scale dtype. BF16 scales imply BF16 per-element dequantization rounding before ordinary linear arithmetic. Its zero-only epsilon substitution and typed divide must not be replaced by an arbitrary F32 minimum floor or reciprocal recipe. TOKEN rank behavior and all qualifications are retained in contract-review.json.
contract_boundaries.deployment_fp8_dot_candidate: The distinct SM89 deployment candidate first performs an explicitly low-precision FP8 code dot to F32, then ordered RN32(S*As), RN32(P*Cast(Ws,F32)^T), and final BF16_RNE. It does not establish equivalence to CT BF16 QDQ or to strict Cast(FP8,F32)+F32 MatMul.
contract_boundaries.acceptance: No deployment quantizer/version, model quality or accepted quantitative FP8 dot error contract was established by this read-only research.

artifact.fact: All186 language-role weights are F8_E4M3 [N,K] codes with separate BF16[N,1] scales; all actual N,K are divisible16. Existing ignore list leaves mixed BF16 roles.
artifact.not_proven: No weight values, scale positivity/finiteness, calibration quality, base-model commit or deployed runtime version inferred from headers.

authoritative_report.role: Authoritative corrected read-only report; preserved byte-for-byte

superseded_report.role: Superseded first report; its FlashInfer decorator eligibility reading is corrected by contract-review.json

review_correction: Corrected one FlashInfer architecture-eligibility reading after tracing the actual decorator body: common-check CC metadata does not gate named-backend calls. No product/runtime claim changed.

existing_numeric_failure.conclusion: Seven actual Windows SM89 shapes execute and capture/replay, but all violate the existing strict F32 coded-dot reference error bound. Do not replace the public FP8 Cast/Cast/F32 MatMul subgraph with this carrier.
